document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Oversized, ape-like faces stare at you from the darkness. Your 
fevered mind races. Sasquatches! The legendary haunters of the 
Canadian wild! If you could communicate—but you  do  not 
need advanced anthropological training to read their sudden 
hostility to this intruder in their den.
